Name: Monford Velaryon
Quirks: speaks with the authority of a man whose power is the sea
references ships tides and naval matters with the ease of his life's expertise
loyal to Stannis in the way of a naval lord who has made a practical alliance
CharacterDescription: Monford Velaryon is the Lord of the Tides at Driftmark - head of one of the great naval houses of Westeros with deep historical ties to the Targaryen dynasty and a current strategic alliance with Stannis Baratheon. He is in his thirties or forties, a sea lord whose power is measured in ships rather than cavalry. House Velaryon's fleet is part of Stannis Baratheon's naval strength. He has an illegitimate half-brother Aurane Waters, the Bastard of Driftmark.
AIGeneratedBackstory: Monford Velaryon is the Lord of the Tides, the Master of Driftmark, and the head of House Velaryon. Aurane Waters, the Bastard of Driftmark, is his bastard half-brother. He has a young son and heir, Monterys Velaryon.
AdditionalContext: Campaign context: At Driftmark or commanding Stannis's fleet two days before Ned Stark's execution.
